readout.purpose: Mono, uppercase, wide-tracked telemetry micro-labels only.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: shadow-sm — every card at rest; keeps surfaces off the page rather than flush.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: .shadow-card — six-layer ink-tinted soft stack for feature/interactive cards; ambient, floating, never a hard drop shadow.

motion.name: veil-lift
motion.purpose: Duotone photo veil thins on card hover (opacity only, no transform on the image).

motion.name: figure-expand
motion.purpose: DemoGallery grows a thumbnail into its lightbox — confident arrival, quick off the mark, long settle.

motion.name: figure-page
motion.purpose: Lightbox paging: next shot enters from the side you paged toward.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Primary action — a soft diagonal teal-to-violet gradient wash with ink text. Quiet confidence, not a loud fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #0d3d3d; background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom right, rgba(53,20,49,0.20), #e2e6f0 55%, #d6e6e5); transition: opacity 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-default:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15,90,91,0.5); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-priority action — solid Azure Mist with ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #0d3d3d; background: #d6e6e5; transition: background 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #c3d6d5; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15,90,91,0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Tertiary action — bordered on card, teal-tinted fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #d8e3e2; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #0d3d3d; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(13 61 61 / 0.05); transition: background 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #e2e6f0; color: #2e3a54; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15,90,91,0.5); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Lifted white content surface on the tinted page field.
components.html:
Advanced GenAI Apps
Build multi-agent orchestration on Vantiq.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #0d3d3d; border: 1px solid #d8e3e2; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(13 61 61 / 0.05); transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: rgb(13 61 61 / 0.04) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgb(13 61 61 / 0.04) 0px 3px 3px -1.5px, rgb(13 61 61 / 0.04) 0px 6px 6px -3px, rgb(13 61 61 / 0.04) 0px 12px 12px -6px, rgb(13 61 61 / 0.04) 0px 24px 24px -12px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 14px; color: #5b6a85; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Solid primary teal status pill; secondary and outline variants available.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; color: #ffffff; background: #0f5a5b; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Filled text field with hairline border and a primary focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #d8e3e2; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; color: #0d3d3d; background: #e9f1f0; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5b6a85; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #0f5a5b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15,90,91,0.5); }

components.name: Tracking Readout Label
components.description: The signature mono, uppercase, wide-tracked telemetry micro-label used on progress trackers.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; } .ds-readout-key { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #5b6a85; } .ds-readout-val { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #0f5a5b; }

narrative.overview: The portal is a guided reference for partners moving through unfamiliar territory — learning the platform, building integrations, registering and closing deals. Like a field atlas, it earns trust through structure, legible wayfinding, and honest depiction rather than spectacle: every screen orients the reader, and imagery functions as landmarks, not decoration. The people using it are building high-stakes, real-time, event-driven systems, so the surface stays calm and capable while remaining unmistakably warm and human. The system is teal-anchored and duotone-disciplined: a single stormy teal carries action and identity, a deep dark-teal ink carries nearly all text, and a Midnight Violet emphasis accent appears rarely. Photography is always pulled through a teal-duotone treatment so unrelated images read as one set. Type is dense and small-first, with a distinctive mono uppercase readout voice for telemetry. Surfaces are consistently lifted on a soft ink-tinted shadow, and motion is restrained and never load-bearing — the resting state is always the finished state.
keyCharacteristics: Teal-anchored palette with a rare Midnight Violet emphasis accent
Duotone-unified photography — no raw stock imagery, ever
Dense, small-first typography with a mono telemetry-readout voice
Consistently lifted surfaces on soft, ink-tinted shadow

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Midnight Violet emphasis is an accent, not a build color. It appears on ≤10% of any screen — a heading, one gradient edge, a single badge. Its rarity is what makes it read as emphasis.

rules.name: The Never-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: The page field is #f3f8f7, not white. White is reserved for lifted surfaces (cards, popovers). This is what lets 'consistently lifted' read without heavy shadows.

rules.name: The Section-Heading Rule
rules.body: A section heading is text-sm font-medium text-emphasis (components/section-heading.tsx) — one definition, portal-wide. Do not reinvent it per page.

rules.name: The Readout-Voice Rule
rules.body: The mono uppercase treatment is only for genuine telemetry readouts (progress state, live-tracking labels). It is never a section heading and never decoration.

rules.name: The Ink-Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are never neutral grey/black in light mode — they are tinted to the portal's ink (rgb(var(--shadow-color) / 0.04)). A raw black drop shadow is off-system.

dos: Do put all text on the ink color (#0d3d3d) and reserve Stormy Teal (#0f5a5b) for action, identity, and state.
Do run every photograph through the teal-duotone treatment (desaturate + bg-primary multiply scrim) so imagery reads as one Vantiq set. This is binding — no raw stock photography reaches the UI.
Do use SectionHeading for section headings and the mono readout voice only for genuine telemetry.
Do keep surfaces lifted: white cards on the #f3f8f7 field, shadow-sm at rest escalating to .shadow-card for feature cards.
Do keep body copy at text-sm and let headings stay modest — this is a dense, information-first workspace.
Do ship every new color and component with a dark-mode value; dark mode is first-class.
donts: Don't spend Midnight Violet emphasis freely — it's an accent for ≤10% of a screen, never a build color.
Don't use raw grey/black drop shadows; shadows are ink-tinted.
Don't put the mono uppercase treatment on anything that isn't a telemetry readout.
Don't introduce new palette entries, radii, or one-off component patterns — extend the existing tokens in app/globals.css.
Don't let motion become load-bearing: the resting state must be the finished state, and every animation must respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Don't use pure white as a page background — that flattens the 'consistently lifted' depth model.
